Title: Azure Monitor managed service for Prometheus now supports TLS & mTLS based scraping

Body.Content: Azure Monitor managed service for Prometheus now supports TLS & mTLS based scraping for Prometheus instance served with TLS. To enable TLS and mTLS based scraping, you can configure the TLS settings in the ConfigMap, and provide a CA certificate to verify the authenticity of the server’s certificate. To learn more, visit: TLS & mTLS based scraping with Azure Managed Prometheus.
